# Isaiah Chapter 37 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 38 verses]*

*Hezekiah prays; Isaiah's oracle; Sennacherib mocked; 185,000 Assyrians struck; Sennacherib killed*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for the sake of my servant David. This chapter hezekiah prays.

*-- LOGOS*
